briefdescription.para: Create an instance of ScheduleDAGInstrs to be run within the standard MachineScheduler pass for this function and target at the current optimization level.

detaileddescription.para: This can also be used to plug a new MachineSchedStrategy into an instance of the standard ScheduleDAGMI: return new ScheduleDAGMI(C, std::make_unique<MyStrategy>(C), /*RemoveKillFlags=*/false)
Return NULL to select the default (generic) machine scheduler.

briefdescription.para: Similar to createMachineScheduler but used when postRA machine scheduling is enabled.
Methods with trivial inline returns are convenient points in the common codegen pass pipeline where targets may insert passes.

detaileddescription.para: Methods with out-of-line standard implementations are major CodeGen stages called by addMachinePasses. Some targets may override major stages when inserting passes is insufficient, but maintaining overriden stages is more work. addPreISelPasses - This method should add any "last minute" LLVM->LLVM passes (which are run just before instruction selector).

briefdescription.para: addMachineSSAOptimization - Add standard passes that optimize machine instructions in SSA form.

detaileddescription.para: Add passes that optimize machine instructions in SSA form.

briefdescription.para: Add passes that optimize instruction level parallelism for out-of-order targets.

detaileddescription.para: These passes are run while the machine code is still in SSA form, so they can use MachineTraceMetrics to control their heuristics.
All passes added here should preserve the MachineDominatorTree, MachineLoopInfo, and MachineTraceMetrics analyses.

briefdescription.para: addInstSelector - This method should install an instruction selector pass, which converts from LLVM code to machine instructions.
This method should install an IR translator pass, which converts from LLVM code to machine instructions with possibly generic opcodes.
This method may be implemented by targets that want to run passes immediately before legalization.
This method should install a legalize pass, which converts the instruction sequence into one that can be selected by the target.
This method may be implemented by targets that want to run passes immediately before the register bank selection.
This method should install a register bank selector pass, which assigns register banks to virtual registers without a register class or register banks.
This method may be implemented by targets that want to run passes immediately before the (global) instruction selection.

This method should install a (global) instruction selector pass, which converts possibly generic instructions to fully target-specific instructions, thereby constraining all generic virtual registers to register classes.
addFastRegAlloc - Add the minimum set of target-independent passes that are required for fast register allocation.

detaileddescription.para: Add the minimum set of target-independent passes that are required for register allocation.

briefdescription.para: addOptimizedRegAlloc - Add passes related to register allocation.

detaileddescription.para: Add standard target-independent passes that are tightly coupled with optimized register allocation, including coalescing, machine instruction scheduling, and register allocation itself.
CodeGenTargetMachineImpl provides standard regalloc passes for most targets.

briefdescription.para: addMachinePasses helper to create the target-selected or overriden regalloc pass.

detaileddescription.para: Find and instantiate the register allocation pass requested by this target at the current optimization level.
Different register allocators are defined as separate passes because they may require different analysis.
This helper ensures that the regalloc= option is always available, even for targets that override the default allocator.
FIXME: When MachinePassRegistry register pass IDs instead of function ptrs, this can be folded into addPass.

briefdescription.para: Add core register allocator passes which do the actual register assignment and rewriting.

simplesect.para: true if any passes were added.

briefdescription.para: addPreRewrite - Add passes to the optimized register allocation pipeline after register allocation is complete, but before virtual registers are rewritten to physical registers.

detaileddescription.para: These passes must preserve VirtRegMap and LiveIntervals, and when running after RABasic or RAGreedy, they should take advantage of LiveRegMatrix. When these passes run, VirtRegMap contains legal physreg assignments for all virtual registers.
Note if the target overloads addRegAssignAndRewriteOptimized, this may not be honored. This is also not generally used for the fast variant, where the allocation and rewriting are done in one pass.

briefdescription.para: This method may be implemented by targets that want to run passes after register allocation pass pipeline but before prolog-epilog insertion.
This method may be implemented by targets that want to run passes after prolog-epilog insertion and before the second instruction scheduling pass.
This pass may be implemented by targets that want to run passes immediately before machine code is emitted.
